content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that allows you to create and publish websites directly from a GitHub repository. This means you can host your digital product store without incurring monthly fees or relying on third-party platforms that charge high commissions. In contrast, platforms like Gumroad take up to 10% on every sale, which can quickly add up. With GitHub Pages, you gain full control over your store, ensuring that your earnings remain intact and your infrastructure is sustainable. This self-hosted model empowers you to sell ebooks, courses, and other digital products with minimal overhead, allowing for greater financial freedom.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

To understand how GitHub Pages serves your digital store, it's important to grasp the underlying architecture. When you deploy your site on GitHub Pages, you're essentially using a static site generator to convert your content into a live website. You can integrate backend functionality using Google Apps Script, which can handle order processing and payment verification seamlessly. This combination not only simplifies the setup but also maximizes efficiency, allowing you to automate product delivery through tools like NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This architecture is designed for creators who want independence from traditional payment platforms, providing a streamlined process from product sale to delivery.
Who This Is Built For and Why

GitHub Pages is tailored for digital creators in regions experiencing financial isolation or restrictive access to conventional payment methods. Whether you're selling ebooks, templates, or software, this infrastructure is specifically crafted to meet your needs without the reliance on platforms like PayPal or Gumroad. By utilizing GitHub Pages, your audience can purchase directly with crypto, eliminating the need for cumbersome payment gateways. This approach not only enhances your earning potential but also ensures that you retain full ownership of your content and customer data, creating a more sustainable business model.
GitHub Pages eliminates hosting costs entirely.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of a digital product store on GitHub Pages hinges on several key components. First, you need a GitHub repository to host your site. Next, Google Apps Script can be used to automate order processing and product delivery. Integrating NOWPayments allows for direct cryptocurrency payment processing with minimal fees. Finally, using a storage solution like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 enables you to securely deliver your digital products to customers instantly upon purchase. Together, these components create a cohesive and efficient digital commerce stack that empowers creators to sell without traditional barriers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital store on GitHub Pages, start by creating a GitHub repository and setting up your site using a static site generator of your choice. Once your site is live, implement Google Apps Script for backend order management. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions to facilitate payments. Ensure you have a reliable file delivery system in place, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, to manage and distribute your digital products. Lastly, promote your store through social media and other channels to drive traffic and sales. For comprehensive resources, consider the Complete Builder Kit, which includes everything you need to build and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by leveraging platforms like GitHub Pages combined with Google Apps Script and NOWPayments. This setup allows you to host your digital store for free and accept cryptocurrency payments with minimal fees, providing a sustainable way to sell without conventional payment barriers.
NOWPayments offers the lowest fees in the industry at 0.5%.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a structured approach to building your digital commerce stack, check out our Complete Builder Kit ($197). It provides all six blueprints and seven templates necessary to establish and operate your store effectively. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up GitHub Pages for my digital store?

To set up GitHub Pages, create a new repository on GitHub and push your site files to it. Enable GitHub Pages in the repository settings, selecting the branch that contains your site files. Your store will then be live at a GitHub URL.
What payment options can I offer without traditional platforms?
You can accept cryptocurrency payments through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. This allows you to bypass traditional payment restrictions and retain more of your earnings.
How do I automate product delivery?
Use Google Apps Script to create a simple backend that triggers email notifications with download links upon successful payment. This automates the delivery of your digital products to customers.
Can I sell other types of digital products on GitHub Pages?
Yes, GitHub Pages is suitable for selling various digital products, including courses, templates, and software. The flexibility of the infrastructure allows for diverse product offerings.
What are the costs associated with using GitHub Pages?

GitHub Pages is free to use, allowing you to host your digital store without any monthly fees. The only costs you may incur will be from transaction fees when using NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing.
